role: District Representative · Surigao del Sur, 2nd District
profileLabel: Mildly left economics; mixed on institutions (low-medium confidence)
summary: Surigao del Sur 2nd District representative with 79 principal-authored bills. Authored a P200 daily wage increase, automatic regional minimum wage adjustments, an anti-dynasty ban, stronger Comelec powers, limits on candidate substitution, a postponement of the barangay and SK elections, bills fixing their terms, an income tax exemption for election board teachers, travel-tax abolition and expanded espionage law coverage.
caveat: Espionage expansion is a single civil-liberties issue and unscored. Postponement bills were widely co-sponsored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a P200 daily wage increase and automatic regional minimum wage adjustments (-2 to -3, labor), income tax exemption for election board teachers (-1) and travel tax abolition (+1). Two issues.
